Describes RISC-V RNMI operation; has nothing to do with condition variable waits in a while loop.

grades.quote: The playback thread checks that variable before displaying each frame, and if paused, waits on a condition variable.
grades.reason: Covers POSIX condition variable API (cond_wait, mutex, signal/broadcast) and a pause-flag example where the state is checked before waiting. It never explains why the wait belongs in a while loop, so it is only limited background.

grades.quote: Other threads that don’t care can simply go back to waiting.
grades.reason: Discusses notify vs notifyAll and says woken threads that cannot proceed go back to waiting, which touches the re-check-in-a-loop idea. It does not directly state why waits should be in a while loop.
